summary: Retest of iteration_2 dark-mode contrast regressions on Verdaleaf. All 3 previously reported issues are FIXED. Also verified: severity/health palette brighter in dark, disease-library severity + 'Treatment ·' labels legible, Download PDF hover readable, theme persistence + no-flash, real Gemini detect flow (Healthy leaf 98%) + PDF download (475,685 bytes) both work in dark mode, and light-mode regression is clean.

issues: White text on hover bg rgb(75,139,84) measures ~4.1:1 contrast — passes WCAG AA for large text but is just below the 4.5:1 threshold for normal 14px. Readable but borderline. Consider darkening --bot-hover in dark mode (currently 128 30% 42%) to widen the margin, or keeping bg-botanical-forest fixed at ~34%L on hover.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dark mode is production-ready. All 3 iteration_2 contrast bugs resolved. Only nit is Download PDF hover at ~4.1:1 (borderline WCAG AA for small text). Full flow (upload → detect → PDF) works in dark. Light mode is regression-clean.
rca of the issue: iteration_2 root cause: --bot-forest was lighter than --bot-sage in dark palette, inverting the light-mode 'sage bg + forest fg' pairing. Main agent's fix: added dark: overrides (bg-botanical-moss/20 + text-botanical-moss) at the component level instead of retuning the palette, keeping light mode byte-identical. Verified via computed styles: active tab = moss on sage, step pills = moss on moss/20, upload chip likewise. Fix confirmed effective.
